about_the_game:
Step into the adorable world of Lumen the Red Panda, a family-friendly 3D platformer full of fun and adventure.

Guide Lumen through colorful levels packed with challenges, including:

  • Platforming elements: steady rocks, floating platforms, moving crates, and spinning logs that throw you off if you stay too long

  • Puzzles: push boxes to build paths and reach places you couldn’t otherwise

  • Mischievous enemies: playful tricksters rolling barrels or blocking your way

Your goal is simple but rewarding:

  • Collect every apple scattered across the level

  • Uncover hidden Fun Fact stones that share real-life facts about red pandas

  • Claim the Golden Apple at the end of each level to unlock new abilities

Along the way, Lumen will grow stronger, unlocking exciting new abilities like Dash, Double Jump, Gliding, and Strong Attack, making every stage more dynamic and fun to explore.

As you progress, you’ll travel through different biomes: from peaceful meadows and bamboo forests to fiery autumn woods and sunny deserts. Each biome introduces new challenges and secrets waiting to be discovered.

Key Features:

  • Cute, stylized 3D platformer gameplay

  • Family-friendly puzzles and playful enemies

  • Multiple biomes with unique visuals and challenges

  • Hidden “Fun Fact” stones with educational red panda trivia

  • Unlockable abilities that expand your movement and exploration

  • Relaxing, cheerful music to accompany your adventure

Join Lumen on a lighthearted journey full of exploration, learning, and fun. Collect apples, master new abilities, and discover the world of Lumen the red panda!

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 11400H
